headline: H100 SXM leads weekly gains at +7% while MI300X holds the best price-performance at $3.62 per PFLOP-hour.
bullets: H100 SXM's market index rose +7% over 7 days to $4.62, and its hyperscaler premium of +151% is the widest of any GPU.
B200 climbed +3% to a $8.50 index, with hyperscalers at $14.12 versus $7.99 for both neocloud and marketplace.
MI300X offers the best price-performance at $3.62 per PFLOP-hour, though only 4 providers list it, and RunPod Secure Cloud is cheapest at $2.39.
H200, A100 80GB SXM, L40S and MI300X were flat at +0%, with H200 indexed at $5.40 and a +95% hyperscaler premium.
Marketplace pricing undercuts neoclouds sharply on older parts, with A100 80GB SXM at $1.32 versus $2.30 and Vast.ai cheapest at $1.26.
watch: Whether H100 SXM's +7% weekly rise spreads to H200, which is still flat at +0% with a $5.40 index.
